items.title: PacMan-ish
items.name: PacManish-1.0.4.zip
items.description: Variation on PacMan translated for Wii U
items.author: Martin Butler
items.details:
This is a variation on PacMan that I wrote a number of years ago. My then 8 year old son designed the screen and the images and told me how he wanted the game to play. I then wrote the game in Java. As a programming exercise I've now converted it to C, to run on the Wii U under Homebrew (https://wiiubrew.org/). It uses the OSScreen interfaces for the graphics and sndcore2 for the sound.

The images used by Draw.c have been converted from bitmap files into two dimensional arrays in .h files, so that they can easily be incorporated into the software. This is done using the tool https://github.com/MartinButlerAAA/ProcessBmp.

The Sounds.c code has been developed using https://github.com/ashquarky/LiveSynthesisU as an example. The code uses .wav sound files that have been converted to data arrays in .h files (I have borrowed the sounds I used from https://scratch.mit.edu/). The .wav files are converted to .h files using the tool https://github.com/MartinButlerAAA/ProcessWav.

items.title: Conway's Game of Life
items.name: ConwaysGameofLife-0.1.zip
items.description: Conway's Game of Life for the Wii U !
items.author: MathewDiMarco, Benchaton
items.details:
Description :
An implementation of Conway's Game of Life in C/C++ and SDL2.

Cells record their age. Red cells are volatile and changing; the older stationary cells emerge as
green. Hovering the pointer over groups of cells will illuminate them.

Controls :
+: pause/play
R: toggle wireframe
L: toggle colorization
ZL: reduce pointer speed
ZR: increase pointer speed
L Stick: move the pointer
Dpad Up: slow down
Dpad Down: speed up
A: spawn cell
B: delete cell
X: grow spawn perimeter
Y: shrink spawn perimeter

items.title: Riivolution
items.name: riivolution-v1.06.zip
items.author: Aaron tueidj Tempus megazig
items.details:
Riivolution is an on-the-fly game patcher for use with retail discs. It allows users to place content on their SD or USB devices, which will be read by the game during regular play. Riivolution can be used for custom textures, music, levels, memory patches, game translations, and more.

Riivolution requires valid game content and an XML file to apply changes to games.

http://rvlution.net/riivolution
items.requirements: vWii Homebrew Channel and the original supported retail disc. Riivolution patch XML must match the disc game/region. Optional channel installation writes NAND; it is not required to launch the app from HBC.
items.setup: Extract the complete apps/riivolution folder to SD root. Keep each mod’s XML in /riivolution/ and its data at the paths named inside that XML. Launch from HBC with your retail disc inserted. Disable patches to return to the original game.
